nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

A message received from a mobile device whose term meaning is used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device by a server, whose terms carry meaning used to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, or forwarded with the short message.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; relevant context data is linked to and formatted with the short message.<SEP>A message generated by a device to which relevant context data is linked.

A device that generates a short message and query, and to which received context data may be provided; also referred to as the receiving mobile device.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to a short message generated by the mobile device.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>At least one server that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.

A type determined by the meaning of a term of the short message that provides information about the context or environment of the device that generated the short message.<SEP>A type of context data determined algorithmically from the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.<SEP>A type algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides a context-data type and provides context data with a cost value.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type and from which context data of that type is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, and context data is requested from them.

Data provided by a context-data source, having a cost value and a context-data type.<SEP>Data of a determined context-data type received from a context-data source, which may be ranked, provided to devices, associated with or appended to a short message, stored in a database, or encoded with a markup language.<SEP>Data of a context-data type obtained from a context-data source, possibly by a physical sensor, and rendered, appended, or linked to a short message.

A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, which may be a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A parameter used to rank context-data sources or received context data, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.
A mobile device that receives context data, to which received context data may be provided, and to which a short message and context data may be forwarded.
A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.
A server that stores a database and sends context data to a receiving mobile device.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into the short message.
A cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.

An available communication network whose state may be a specified parameter.<SEP>An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter.<SEP>A network through which context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A mobile device that receives context data from the database server and whose state may be a specified parameter.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the program instructions.
A component of the computerized apparatus having program instructions.

A component of the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, identifying and ranking context-data sources, and generating context-data requests.
Instructions appended to query the database for the received context data in the short message.
Instructions executed by at least one processor to perform operations related to short messages and context data.

A provider from which a set of context data related to a meaning of short message content is collected by at least one server.<SEP>A provider of context-data that may be allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.
A measure according to which relevant context data is algorithmically selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A sensor by which context data is obtained.<SEP>A sensor that obtains context-data through physical sensing.

A protocol according to which relevant context data and the short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted.
A communication protocol used for formatting relevant context data and the short message.<SEP>A type of communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A communication protocol used for formatting relevant context data and the short message.<SEP>A type of communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A cost associated with the context-data that a context-data provider may be allowed to provide.
A device that generates the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.
The computer readable medium comprises computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.

edges.description: The patent US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method algorithmically determines a context-data type from a query, based on the meaning of a term of the short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type, ranks the source according to a specified parameter, and generates a request for context data from the source.
The method acquires and ranks received context data and provides it to devices or associates it with a short message.
The method ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter.
The method processes a short message, associates context data with a component of the short message, appends context data to it, and encodes context data into it.
The method provides received context data to the device that generated the short message.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device and forwards the short message and context data to the recipient mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The server receives a short message from a mobile device.
The mobile device generates and sends a short message to the server.

The context-data type is algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.<SEP>The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.<SEP>The context-data type is determined by a meaning of a term of the short message.
edges.keywords: determination,determined by meaning of term,determined from term meaning,term meaning
